|---|-------------|------|
| 1 | cli | `agent-tools/cli.md` |
| 2 | read | `agent-tools/read.md` |
| 3 | edit | `agent-tools/edit.md` |
| 4 | canvas | `agent-tools/canvas.md` |
| 5 | fetch | `agent-tools/fetch.md` |
| 6 | search | `agent-tools/search.md` |
| 7 | dida | `agent-tools/dida.md` |
| 8 | image | `agent-tools/image.md` |
